sources.harvard_location: Tozzer Library, call number N.A.LING. K 913 la; Widener Library, call number Arc 307.2 vol.9; Tozzer Library (offsite storage), call number L.SOC.120.Cf.5 (9:3)
sources.note: Only accent statements are for Northern Sierra Miwok (p. 279: stress 'may be found on any syllable between the first and the last'; long vowels and vowels before glottal stop/geminate 'generally bear the accent') and the Southern Sierra plural accent shift (p. 296). The Coast (Marin/Bodega) dialect section pp. 292-320 has no word-stress statement; p. 305 only calls Coast pronominal elements 'accentless particles or proclitics'. Silent for coas1301.
